[opaque block] Google Vault - upcoming meeting with DA Coleman on disinformation
urged us to explore such a Council as quickly as possible, and you will all receive an
Action Memo for clearance in the next week or two proposing its basic parameters. After
initial introductions and opening remarks from DA Coleman, I will provide an overview of
key lines of effort and initiatives we hope this Council will take on and coordinate across
the Agency. We will then open the floor to your insights and questions.
As this process gets underway, we would like to request your input on the following items:
• Please ID a senior level POC (either you or a DAA) to attend roughly
bimonthly senior level meetings like this one.
• Consider who in your Bureau at the technical level who can give a portion of
their time to participate in the working group that will carry out much of the
Council's substantive work.
• Consider whatthe mainchallenges toyourbureau are related to this issue,
and how an optimal Council might meaningfully address them.
Thanks so much, and please let me know if you have any questions!
Vera
